name: boomi-cockpit
description: A live summary of a Boomi Companion session: builds, tests, deploys, the environment's runs, watched components and the session's cost

envFile.title: Companion .env file
envFile.description: Path of Boomi Companion's .env, relative to the session's working directory; the cockpit reads the Platform API credentials and BOOMI_ENVIRONMENT_ID from it

pollSeconds.title: Platform poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to poll the Platform API for the environment's runs and the watched components; 0 turns polling off

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Pop up a toast when a test, deploy or platform run fails, a deploy finishes, or a watched component changes

banner.title: Banner above the prompt
banner.description: Show a one-row summary above the prompt once there is Companion activity
